tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas lnga pa'i tshig 'grel bzhugs/

gnyis pa nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung bshad pa la/ spang bya phra rgyas nyon mongs bshad pa/ de ji ltar spong tshul bshad pa/ spangs pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba/ skye tshul/ rnam grangs dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ rnam pa'i sgo nas/ bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ lta ba dang nga rgyal bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa ba dang*/ nang tshan dang*/ gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye ba gsum/ dang po la/ tshig don/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /'dod chags de bzhin khong khro dang*/ /nga rgyal ma rig lta ba dang*/ /the tshom yin te de drug kyang*/ /'dod chags dbye bas bdun du bshad/ khams gnyis las skyes srid 'dod chags/ kha ni nang du bltas phyir der/ /thar pa'i 'du shes bzlog phyir bshad/ /ces byung*/ srid pa'i rtsa ba chos can/ khyod la ngo bo'i sgo nas drug yod de/ phra rgyas drug yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod chags phra rgyas dang*/ de bzhin du khong khro dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ ma rig pa dang*/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i lta ba dang*/ the tshom nyon mongs pa drug yod pa'i phyir/ de drug kyang chos can/ khyod la bdun du'ang bshad de/ 'dod pa dang srid pa'i 'dod chags gnyis su dbye bas de ltar yod pa'i phy-ir/ khams gong ma gnyis las skyes pa'i 'dod chags chos can/ srid pa'i 'dod chags/ zhes gcig tu bya ste/ phal cher snyoms 'jug la chags pa'i kha ni nang du bltas par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ srid pa'i 'dod chags zhes bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ srid pa ste 'khor ba'i khyad par la chags kyang der thar pa'i 'du shes 'byung bas de bzlog par bya ba'i phyir de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs kyi mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ phyed las/ dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems rgyud ma zhi bar byed pa rigs gnas kyi sems byung de/

nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid du rigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ sems blong blong por byed pas sam ma zhi bar byed pas na nyon mongs zhes bya la/ rjes su 'brel ba'i nyon mongs pa phra ba'ang rgyas par byed pas na phra rgyas zhes bya ba'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ nyon mongs pa sogs kyi rgyun brtan pa dang*/ gnas par byed pa sogs bcu yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rtsa nyon drug dang*/ nye nyon nyi shu dang*/ rnam par sgo nas bcu dang*/ khams kyi sgo nas go brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/rtsa nyon drug po gang rung yin na/ phra rgyas yin pas khyab zer na/ skad cig tha ma'i nyon mongs drug re re nas chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ rtsa nyon yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na min de/ gzhan rgyas par mi byed cing*/ rang nyid kyang rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir der thal/ rgyun chad kha ma'i de yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/phra rgyas kyi don la 'dod tshul mi mthun pa mang zer na/ de yod par thal/ bye smras nyon mongs la 'dod/ gnas ma bu pas nyon mongs kyi thob pa la der btags par 'dod/ slob dpon dang mdo sde pas nyon mongs kyi sa bon la der btags par 'dod ces rang 'grel las bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig/'dir bstan phra rgyas la sgom spang gis khyab zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ mthong spang phra rgyas kyang yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhung 'di de gnyis thun mong du 'chad byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ lta ba lnga ste 'jig tshogs dang*/ /log dang mthar 'dzin lta ba dang*/ /lta ba dang ni tshul khrims dang*/ /brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin dang bcu/ /zhes byung*/ phra rgyas chos can/ khyod la nang tshan gyis dbye na bcu yod de/ lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i 'jig lta dang*/ log lta dang*/ mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba dang*/ lta ba mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba dang*/

tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba ste lnga dang*/ lta min lnga dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ bshad pa ltar 'dod chags sogs lnga yod pa'i phyir gsum pa la/ dngos dang*/ gnyen pos spang bya spong tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med kyi de gnyis/ dang po la/ mthong lam dang sgom lam gyi spang bya gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dag bcu dang bdun bdun brgyad/ /lta ba gsum gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /'dod na sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /mthong bas rim bzhin spong bar byed/ /ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod na phra rgyas de dag sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ sdug bsngal mthong spang la lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga ste bcu dang*/ sogs kyis kun 'byung dang 'gog pa mthong spang la 'jig lta dang mthar lta dang tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba gsum ma gtogs pa'i gzhan bdun bdun dang*/ lam mthor spang la 'jig lta dang mthar lta gnyis ma gtogs pa'i gzhan brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i phra rgyas de chos can/ mthong spang yin te/ mthong ba'i lam gyis rim pa bzhin du spong bar byed dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bzhi ni sgom pa'i spang bya yin/ zhes byung*/ 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa bzhi ni chos can/ sgom pa'i lam gyis spang bar bya ba yin te/ bden pa mthong ba tsam gyis spaung mi nus kyi/ phyis rim gyis spong bar byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ de dag bcu dang bdun bdun brgyad/ ces pa'i gzhung gis mthong spang dngos su bstan nas sgom spang nyid dngos su 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/ sgom spang yin na/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sgom spang yin pas ma khyab ste/ khams gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spang de 'di'i dngos bstan gyi de ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dis 'dod pa'i sgom spang nyid 'chad par mdzad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gong ma'i sas bsdus pa'i de bzhi med pa'i phyir/ der thal/

de'i sas bsdus pa'i khong khro med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ khong khro ma gtogs de dag nyid/ /gzugs khams gzugs med de dang 'dra/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs khams gyis sa bsdus pa'i phra rgyas sgom spangs chos can/ khyod la so gcig re yod de/ khong khro lnga ma gtogs pa'i so gcig de dag nyid yod cing*/ gzugs med na'ang de dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ de ltar dgu bcu brgyad du 'dod/ /ces pa ni don bsdu ba yin te/ 'dod pa na so drug dang gong ma gnyis na so gcig ma yod pa'i khyon bsdoms 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung 'gog pa gnyis la dmigs nas log par zhugs pa'i lta ba gsum mi 'ong ste/ 'jig ltas ni nyer len gyi phung po la dmigs nas 'jug mthar ltas phung po de dag rtag chad gang rung lta/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi ni phung po la 'dag grol sogs su lta bas sdug bden nyid la dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam mthong spang la 'jig lta mthar lta gnyis mi 'jog ste/ de gnyis kyis nyer len gyi phung po la dmigs dgos pa'i phyir/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin kyang mi 'jog ste/ des lam ngan pa la lam mchog tu dmigs nas 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ srid rtse las skyes bzod pa yis/ /gzhom bya mthong bas spang bya nyid/ /lhag skyes mthong dag sgom gnyis kyis/ /bzod pas gzhom min sgom kho nas/ /zhes byung*/ /phra rgyas rnams mthong lam kho nas spong mi nus pas/ de la gnyis yod pa'i srid rtse las skyes pa'i sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi'i mthong spang phra rgyas chos can/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba kho na nyid yin te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod la sogs pa bzhi yis gzhom par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de bzhis bden pa mngon sum du mthong ba tsam gyis khyod spong nus pa'i phyir/ srid rtse'i lhag ma 'dod pa dang khams gong ma las skyes pa'i phra rgyas chos can/ mthong lam dang sgom lam gnyis kyis spong bar byed de/

'das lam gyis spong ba'i tshe mthong lam gyis spong zhing*/ so skyes 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyis spong ba yang yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam bzod pas gzhom bya min pa'i lta min bzhi chos can/ sgom spang kho na yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam dang 'das pa'i sgom lam ci rigs kyis spong pa'i phyir/ khyad par yod de/ snga mas srid rtse'i de spong mi nus shing*/ phyi mas thams cad spong nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lta ba dang nga rgyal bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ dogs gcod gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag dang bdag gir rtag chad dang*/ /ming dang dman la mchog lta dang*/ /rgyu min lam min der lta ba/ /de dag lta ba lnga yin no/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lta ba ngan pa de dag chos can/ khyod la lnga yod de/ nyer len gyi phung po la dmigs nas bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de 'jig lta/ de la dmigs nas rtag chad gang rung du lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de mthar lta/ las rgyu 'bras sogs yod pa'i don la med par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de log lta/ lta ba dman pa la dmigs nas 'dag pa dang grol byed mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ngan de lta ba mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba/ dbang phyug sogs snod bcud kyi rgyu min pa dang*/ tshul zhugs ngan pa sogs lam min pa la rgyu dang lam der lta ba ni tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba yin na/ de gnyis ka la dmigs nas mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba yin pas khyab zer na/ tshul khrims ngan pa tsam la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ngan chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ kha cig/lta ba lnga po de lta ba yin zer na/ re zhig de mi 'thad par thal/

lta ngan lta bar mi rung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ shes rab nyon mongs can shes rab tu mi rung ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes rab nyon mongs can dang log lta rgyud ldan yin na shes rab can yin pas khyab par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na ha cang thal snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang*/ de lnga lta ba ma yin par thal/ gangs spel las/ log par dmigs pa'i shes rab thams cad ni lta ba mi 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig/lam dang 'gog pa mthong spang gang rung yin na/ 'gog lam gang rung la dmigs pas khyab par thal/ spang bya de dag yul la dmigs nas log par 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ 'gog lam mthong spang du gyur pa'i 'dod chags nga rgyal lta bus de gang rung la dmigs nas mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis kyis yul khyad par can la ma dmigs par zag bcas kyis khyad par la dmigs nas 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang phyug sogs rgyur mngon zhen pa/ /rtag bdag phyin ci log pa yin/ /rab tu 'jug pas de phyir de/ /lta ba gsum lam phyin ci log/ bzhi tshan phyin ci log phyir dang*/ /nges rtog phyir dang sgro 'dogs phyir/ /sems dang 'du shes de'i dbang gis/ /zhes byung*/ dbang phyug sogs 'gro ba'i rgyu min pa la rgyur mngon par zhen pa de chos can/ sdug kun mthong spang yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la log par zhugs pa'i phyir te/ dbang phyug rtag pa dang bdag tu phyin ci log par zhen pa yis rab tu 'jug pas de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de 'dra ba sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ 'jig lta log lta mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba ste lta ba gsum las phye ba'i phyin ci log chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ mi rtag pa la rtag par lta ba dang*/ mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar lta ba dang*/ sdug bsngal la bde bar lta ba dang*/ bdag med pa la bdag tu lta ba'i phyin ci log dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/

lta ba gsum las phyin ci log bzhir phye ba yin te/ mthar lta la rtag 'dzin/ mchog 'dzin la gtsang ba de'i 'dzin pa gnyis/ 'jig lta la bdag lta bzhag pa'i phyir/ phyin ci log bzhi tshan gcig po chos can/ phyin ci log tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dmigs pa la phyin ni log pa'i phyir dang*/ der nges par rtog pa'i phyir dang*/ sgro 'dogs pa'i phyir ro/ khyab ste/ lta ba gzhan dang tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin sogs kyis de ltar sgro mi 'dogs pa'i phyir/ mdo las sems phyin ci log dang 'du shes phyin ci log ces gsungs pa dang mi 'gal te/ de gnyis lta ba phyin ci log de'i dbang gis phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa nga rgyal la/ dbye ba dang*/ spong tshul dogs gcod bcas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nga rgyal bdun nam dgu gsum mo/ /zhes byung*/ nga rgyal chos can/ khyod la du ma yod de/ 'di dang bdag rigs sogs mnyam mo snyam du sems pa'i mnyam pa'i nga rgyal dang de las bdag lhag go snyam pa'i lhag pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ khyad par 'phags pa de las kyang bdag 'phags so snyam pa'i nga rgyal las nga rgyal dang*/ nye bar len pa'i phung po la dmigs nas nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ yon tan gyi khyad par de ma thob kyang thob so snyam pa'i mngon par nga rgyal dang*/ khyad 'phags de las cung zad dman no snyam pa'i cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ yon tan min la yon tan du rlom pa'i log pa'i nga rgyal dang bdun yod cing*/ bstan bcos dag las/ bdag mchog yin no/ /bdag dang 'dra'o/ /bdag dman no/ /bdag pas mchog go /bdag pas dman no/ / bdag dang mnyam pa med do/ /bdag pas dman pa med do/ /bdag dang mnyam pa yod do/ /bdag pas dman pa yod do zhes dgu gsungs pa rnams ni/ nga rgyal dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal dang cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ de dag 'ga' zhig ni nga rgyal dngos min te/ de'i rnam pa lta bu la nga rgyal du btags pa'i phyir/

nga rgyal du 'gro ba la nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa zhig dgos kyi/ bdag mchog go snyam pa lta bu tsam ni nga rgyal min te/ yin na sangs rgyas la'ang nga rgyal yod par thal ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong dang sgom pas zad bya ba/ /sgom pas spang bar bya ba ni/ /gsod dang kun nas dkris pa'o/ /de bzhin 'jig sred 'phags pa la/ / rnam sogs nga'o snyam mi 'byung*/ /lta bas rgyas par 'gyur phyir ro/ /mi dge'i 'gyod pa 'dam yin no/ /zhes byung*/ nga rgyal bdun po de rnams chos can/ khyod la mthong lam dang sgom pa'i lam gyis zad par bya ba'i cha gnyis yod de/ mthong spang rnams mthong lam dang*/ sgom spang rnams sgom lam gyis spong ba'i phyir/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba ni chos can/ khyed la du ma yod de/ gsod pa la sogs pa lus ngag gi mi dge ba rnams dang*/ de dag gi kun slong kun nas dkris pa dang*/ de bzhin du bdag myur du shi na snyam pa'i 'jig sred dang*/ sngar gyi nga rgyal gyi rnam pa bdun dang*/ sogs kyis bdag bud med lta bur skyes na snyam pa'i skye sred dang*/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal rnams 'phags pa la mngon gyur du mi 'byung yang sgom spang yin pa'i phyir/ de dag 'phags pa la mngon gyur du mi 'byung ste/ de dag ni nyon mongs can gyi lta bas rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / 'phags pa la mi dge ba'i 'gyod pa'ang mngon gyur du mi 'byung ste/ de la the tshom yod kyang the tshom nyon mongs can med pa'i phyir gnyis pa rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba la/ kun 'gro yin min gyi sgo nas/ zag med la dmigs ma dmigs kyi sgo nas/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi sgo nas/ dus gsum la phra rgyas kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang lnga/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal rgyu mthong spang bya ba/ /lta dang de bzhin the tshom dang*/ /gang de lhan cig ma 'dres pa'i/ /ma rig gang yin kun tu 'gro

/de dag las kun gong du dmigs/ /lta ba gnyis po ma gtogs pa'i/ /de dag dang ni lhan cig gang*/ /'byung de'ang kun 'gro thob ma gtogs/ /zhes byung*/ /sdug bsngal mthong spang lnga dang*/ rgyu kun 'byung mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i lta ba log lta dang lta ba mchog 'dzin gnyis re dang*/ de bzhin du sdug kun mthong spang gi the tshom gnyis re dang*/ the tshom gang yin pa de dang lhan cig pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ rtsa nyon gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa gnyis re ste khams gsum na bcu gcig de yod pa'i so gsum gang yin pa de chos can/ rang sa'i spang bya rigs lnga la 'gro ba'i skal mnyam kun 'gro yin te/ de lnga la dmigs nas rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bcu gcig po de dag las dgu khams gong du dmigs pa yin te/ 'jig lta mthar lta gnyis ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams kyis der dmigs pa'i phyir/ kun 'gro de dag dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i sems sems byung gang yin pa de yang chos can/ kun 'gro yin te/ de dag dang dmigs rnam mtshungs par 'jug pa'i phyir/ kun 'gro de dag gi thob pa chos can/ phra rgyas kun 'gror ma gtogs te/ khyod dang kun 'gro rnams 'bras bu mi mtshungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ zag med la dmigs pa dang*/ de la ma dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gog dang lam mthong spang bya ba/ /log lta the tshom de dag dang*/ /ldan dang 'ba' zhig ma rig dang*/ /drug ni zag med spyod yul can/ /rang gi sa pa'i 'gog pa dang*/ /lam ni phan tshun rgyu yin pas/ /sa drug sa dgu'i lam ni de'i/ /spyod yul can gyi yul yin no/ /zhes byung*/ 'gog pa dang lam mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i log lta dang*/ the tshom de dag dang*/ de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa dang drug ni chos can/ zag med kyi spyod yul can yin te/ rang gi sa pa'i gog pa dang lam la dmigs pa'i phyir/ lam la dmigs pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i log lta so drug gi dmigs pa bsam gtan bzhi dang mi lcogs med dang khyad par can te bsam gtan sa drug dang chos shes pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam thams cad dang*/

khams gong gi des lam la dmigs pa na mi lcogs med pa nas srid rtse'i bar gyi sa dgu'i rjes shes dang phyogs mthun pa'i gong gi lam rnams la dmigs/ sa drug dang sa dgu'i lam ni rang rang gi sa de'i phan tshun gyi rgyu byed pa'i spyod yul can gyi yul can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags min te spang bya'i phyir/ gnod mi byed phyir zhe sdang min/ /zhi dang dag dang mchog gyur phyir/ /nga rgyal ma yin mchog 'dzin yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'dod chags chos can/ khyod kyis zag med 'gog lam la dmigs pa yin te/ khyod zag bcas la gtso bor dmigs pas thar 'dod kyis gcig tu spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhe sdang chos can/ khyod kyis de la dmigs pa min te/ 'gog lam ni gnod pa mi byed pa'i rang bzhin can yin la/ khyod ni gnod par sems pa can yin pa'i phyir/ nga rgyal chos can/ khyod kyis kyang de la dmigs pa ma yin te/ 'gog lam ni zhi ba yin la/ khyod ni khengs pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin chos can/ khyod kyis kyang de la dmigs pa min te/ 'gog lam rnam par dag pa yin la/ khyod kyi sa ni ma dag la gtso bor dmigs nas mchog tu 'dzin pa'i phyir/ lta ba mchog 'dzin chos can/ khyod kyis kyang 'gog lam la dmigs pa ma yin te/ khyod kyis dman pa la mchog tu 'dzin pa yin la/ 'gog lam ni chos kyi mchog tu gyur pas khyod kyi yul min pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ phra rgyas kun tu 'gro ba ni/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas rang gi sa/ /thams cad du ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /kun 'gro ma yin dang ris su/ /zag med gong ma'i yul can min/ / bdag gir ma byas gnyen po'i phyir/ /gang zhig gang dang mtshungs ldan pa/ /de ni de mtshungs ldan sgo nas/ /zhes byung*/ phra rgyas kun tu 'gro ba rnams ni chos can/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas khams rang gi sa pa'i rnam pa lnga po thams cad du ni rgyas par 'byung ba yin te/

rang sa'i de rnams ni lta bas bdag gir byas pa'i phyir/ kun 'gro ma yin pa'i phra rgyas chos can/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas rang gi sar rang gi ris kho na la rgyas par 'gyur gyi/ /ris gzhan du mi rgyas te/ sdug bsngal mthong sgom gyi spang bya rnams rang sa'i sdug bsngal mthong sgom gyi spang gi ris kho na la rgyas par 'gyur ba sogs yin pa'i phyir/ phra rgyas kun 'gro ma yin pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas rgyas par mi 'gyur ba yang yod de/ zag med la dmigs pa dang*/ gong ma la dmigs pa'i yul can rnams ni dmigs pa'i sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zag med ni bdag ltas bdag gir ma byas pa'i phyir te/ zag med de dag gi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ phra rgyas gang zhig sems byung tshor ba sogs gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sa mang po de ni chos can/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ba yin te/ phra rgyas dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs can yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa la/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa/ de dag tu 'jog pa'i rtsa ba ngos bzung ba/ dri ba dang lan gyis gtan la dbab pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gong ma thams cad lung ma bstan/ /'dod na 'jig chogs lta ba dang*/ mthar 'dzin lhan cig ma rig pa/ /lhag ma rnams 'dir mi dge ba'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi nyon mongs thams cad chos can/ lung ma bstan yin te/ sgrib lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sgrib pa yin yang*/ sa de'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas btul bas rnam smin sdug bsngal 'byin pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa na 'jig tshogs lta ba dang mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba dang*/ de gnyis dang lhan cig pa'i mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa chos can/ sgrib lung ma bstan yin te/ rnam smin ma 'byin pa'i rigs can gyi sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi lhag ma 'dod chags sogs rnams chos can/

'dod pa 'dir mi dge ba yin te/ rnam smin sdug bsngal 'byin byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ mi dge ba'i rtsa ba yin na/ mi dge ba yin pas khyab zer na/ de'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i ma rig pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ phra rgyas ma rig pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /'dod chags yin na/ mi dge ba yin pas khyab zer na/ gong ma'i 'dod chags chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags gsal sla/ kha cig /'dod pa'i mi dge ba yin na/ rnam smin 'byin pas khyab zer na/ bshags pas 'dags nges kyi mi dge ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ khams gong na mi dge ba med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sla'o/ /gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs mi dge ba dang*/ khams gong gi nyon mongs lung ma bstan du 'jog pa'i rtsa ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod na 'dod chags khong khro dang*/ /rmongs rnams mi dge'i rtsa ba yin/ /zhes byung 'dod pa na mi dge ba'i rtsa ba yin pa yod de/ de'i 'dod chags dang khong khro dang lta ba dang po gnyis dang mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i rmongs pa rnams de'i rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha che ba'i lugs dang*/ nyi 'og pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ lung ma bstan pa'i rtsa ba gsum/ de ni sred dang ma rig blo/ /rnam gnyis mthong 'jug phyir de las/ gzhan min zhes byung*/ lung ma bstan pa'i rtsa ba de chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ lung ma bstan gyi sred pa dang de'am rig pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i blo shes rab gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan the tshom dang nga rgyal ni/ de'i bya bar ma yin te/ snga ma ni rnam pa gnyis su 'jug cing*/ phyi ma ni rnam pa mtho bar 'jug pa'i phyir zer/gnyis pa ni/ bzhi zhes nyi 'og pa/

de dag sred lta nga rgyal rmongs/ / bsam gtan sa gsum ma rig las/ /zhes byung*/ lung ma bstan gyi rtsa ba de dag chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ sred pa dang lta ba dang nga rgyal dang rmongs pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sred lta nga rgyal shas che ba'i bsam gtan sa gsum yang ma rig pa'i dbang las de ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir zer ro/ /gsum pa dri lan gyis gtan la phab pa ni/ mgo gcig pa dang rnam phye dang*/ dri dang bzhag pa lung bstan pa/ /'chi dang skye dang khyad par 'phags/ / bdag gzhan la sogs lta bu yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'dir dri ba de chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ mgo gcig tu lung bstan par bya ba dang*/ rnam par phye nas lung bstan pa dang*/ dri bas lung bstan pa dang*/ bzhag par bya ba'i dri ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ sems can 'di rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ram zhes 'dri na 'chi bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ sems can rnams nyon mongs kyis skye'am zhe na nyon mongs can rnams de'i dbang gis skye'o/ /nyon mongs spangs pa rnams ni mi skye zhes rnam par skye nas lung bstan par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ ci mi 'di dman nam khyad par 'phags zhes 'dri na/ gang la ltos te 'dri zhes dris nas lha las ltos te zer na dman la/ ngan song las ltos te zer na khyad par du 'phags zhes lung bstan par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ phung po rnams bdag las gzhan nam gzhan min zhes sogs khyad gzhi gang zag gi bdag la bsams nas 'dri ba'i tshe lan lung mi ston par bzhag par bya ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gang zag gi bdag med pas der grub pa'i bdag ni phung po dang gcig dang tha dad gang du'ang mi rigs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa dus gsum la phra rgyas ldan tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ phra rgyas kyi dmigs yul/ dus gsum ldan tshul lam de'i rnam gzhag bstan pa/

spang bral gy-i khyad par bshad pa/ sems kyi dmigs pa bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ dmigs yul nges can gyi nyon mongs dang*/ nges med kyi nyon mongs gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'das dang nyer gnas 'dod chags dang*/ khong khro nga rgyal dag gis ni/ /gang la de skyes ma spangs pa'i/ /dngos po de dang ldan pa yin/ /yid kyi de dag ma 'ongs pas/ /kun dang gzhan gyi rang dus pa/ /mi skye rnams kyi thams cad dang*/ /zhes byung*/ 'das pa dang da lta bar nye bar gnas pa'i 'dod chags dang khong khro dang nga rgyal dag gis ni chos can/ khyod rang gang la/ rang nyid skyes nas ma spangs kyi bar du yul 'dod sogs dngos po de dang de rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de la ldan par byed pa yin te/ rang gis mtshan nyid pa'i nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam shes kyi 'khor du byung ba'i 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal gsum po de dag chos can/ khyod kyis yul ma 'ongs pa'i dus gsum po kun dang ldan par byed de/ yul gang la de skyes la ma spangs shing*/ yid kyi yul ni dus gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ yid las gzhan pa'i dbang shes dang de'i 'khor gyi nyon mongs rnams chos can/ khyod kyis rang dang dus mnyam pa'i yul dus/ so so kho na dang ldan par byed de/ ma 'ongs pas ma 'ongs pa dang*/ de bzhin du da lta ba dang 'das pa la'ang so sor ldan par byed pa'i phyir/ mi skye ba'i chos can gyi ming can dbang shes rnams chos can/ yul dus gsum pa'i dngos po thams cad dang ldan par byed de/ yul de gsum la dmigs pas mngon du phyogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ lhag ma kun gyis kun dang ldan/ /zhes byung*/ de dag gi lhag ma lta ba dang the tshom dang ma rig pa kun chos can/ khyod rang yul dus gsum pa'i dngos po kun dang ldan te/ de dag skyes la ma spangs shing nyon mongs spyi ba zhes bya ba de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ dus gsum rdzas yod du grub tshul/

dus gsum gyi 'jog tshul/ de la mdo sde pas gcod byed brjod pa/ bye brag smra bas lan btab tshul dang bzhi/ dang po la/ lung dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ dus rnams kun tu yod bshad phyir/ zhes byung*/ dus gsum po chos can/ rnam pa kun tu rdzas su yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gal te 'das pa'i gzugs zhig yod par ma gyur na zhes sogs kyis khyod rdzas yod du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyis kyi yul yod phyir 'bras phyir/ /de yod smra ba'i phyi thams cad/ /yod par smra bar 'dod ces byung*/ da lta bar ma zad/ 'das ma 'ongs gnyis chos can/ rdzas su yod de/ khyod gnyis la dmigs pa'i rnam shes kyi yul dngos po ba yod pa'i phyir dang*/ 'das pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bskyed pa yod par mthong ba'i phyir/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra bas dus gsum rdzas yod du 'dod de/ de rdzas yod du 'dod par kha che ba smra ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de dag /rnam bzhi dngos dang mtshan nyid dang*/ /gnas skabs gzhan gzhan 'gyur zhes bya/ gsum pa bzang ste bya ba yis/ /dus rnams rnam gzhag ces byung*/ yod smra'i lugs la de dag kyang rnam pa bzhir 'dod tshul yod de/ dngos po gzhan du 'gyur ba dang*/ de bzhin du mtshan nyid dang*/ gnas skabs dang*/ snga phyi gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur zhes bya bar smra ba bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni btsun pa chos skyob kyi lugs yin te/ des myu gu lta bu ma 'ongs pa nas da ltar ba dang da lta ba nas ma 'ongs par 'jug pa'i tshe rdzas gzhan du mi 'gyur yang dngos po gzhan du 'gyur bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ dper na/ gser snod bcom nas rgyan byas tshe gser gyi mdog mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'o ma zhor 'gyur ba'i tshe ro nus 'gyur kyang kha dog mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni dbyangs sgrogs kyi lugs yin te/ des de ltar 'jug pa'i tshe myu gu de dus gsum char ldan yang mtshan nyid gang shas che ba'i sgo nas mtshan nyid gzhan du 'gyur bar 'dod pa'i phyir/

dper na/ skyes pa gcig bud med gcig la chags pa'i tshe bud med gzhan la chags pa dang ma bral yang de la chags zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa dbyig bshes kyi lugs yin te/ dus gsum gnas skabs gzhan du 'gyur gyi rdzas gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing*/ sngar ltar 'jug pa'i tshe bya ba ma skyes pa ma 'ongs pa dang*/ bya ba skyes la ma 'gags pa da ltar ba dang*/ bya ba zhig pa 'das pa ste gnas skabs gzhan du 'gyur bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rtsis kyi ril bu gcig ni gcig dang brgya stong sogs kyi sho mig gi go sar bzhag pa na gcig dang brgya sogs su brjod pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni sangs rgyas lha'i lugs yin te/ des de ltar 'jug pa'i tshe snga phyi bar gsum la 'das ma 'ongs da lta ba gsum du 'jog pas gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bud med gcig rang gi ma la ltos nas bu mo dang rang gi bu mo la ltos nas ma dang rang nyid de'i bar du 'jog pa bzhin no zhes zer ro/ /de'i dang po mi 'thad de/ phyi rol grangs can gyi 'dod pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang mi 'thad de/ dus gsum gy-i mtshan nyid 'chol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa yang mi 'thad de/ dus gsum re re yang dus gsum char du thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir lugs gsum pa ni cung zad bzang ste/ bya ba mi byed pas ma 'ongs pa dang*/ byed pa'i tshe da lta ba dang*/ byas nas 'gags pa 'das pa dag gsum po de yi sgo nas dus gsum po rnams rnam par bzhag pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gegs su byed/ /de yang ji ltar gzhan ma yin/ dus gsum me rung do bzhin du/ /yod na ci'i phyir ma skyes zhig /zhes byung*/ mdo sde pa na re/ gsum pa de cung zad bzang yang skyon yod de/ 'das ma 'ongs gnyis kyis 'bras bu skyed pa'i bya ba byed par thal/ de gnyis kyis 'bras bu spang pa la gegs byed pa med pa'i phyir/ bya ba 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba gang yin pa de gang ji ltar bya ba la yang bya ba gzhan zhig yod pa ma yin par thal/

'das pa sogs gang yang min pa'i 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phy-ir/ der thal/ bya ba 'das zin nas med pa de dus su mi rung zhing*/ gang la bya ba mi byed pa'i ma 'ongs pa ni dngos por brjod du mi rung ba'i phyir/ ci'i phyir ma 'ongs pa ni ma skyes shing 'das pa ni zhig pa ma yin par thal/ da lta ba bzhin du de gnyis kyang yod ba'i phyir zer/ bzhi pa ni/ chos nyid dag ni zab pa yin/ zhes byung*/ bye brag smra ba na re/ mdo sde pa'i rtsod pa de kho bo cag la mi gnod par thal/ 'das ma 'ongs de ltar 'jog tu yod pa'i chos nyid de gnas lugs la ni rtogs dka' zhing zab pa yin pas rtog ge tsam gyi yul ma yin pa'i phy-ir ro/ /gsum pa spang bral gyi khyad par ni/ sdug bsngal mthong spang bya spangs kyang*/ kun 'gro lhag ma rnams kyis ldan/ /dang po'i rnam pa spangs kyang de'i/ /yul can dri ma lhag rnams kyis/ /zhes byung*/ skabs 'dir spang bya de dang bral na spangs pas khyab kyang*/ spangs na bral bas ma khyab ste/ sdug bsngal shes pa gnyis skyes la kun 'byung shes pas skyes pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang spangs kyang*/ kun 'gro lhag ma kun 'byung mthong spang rnams kyis dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ des mthong spang gzhan la 'gre ba'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sgom spang dang po'i rnam pa ste chen po'i chen po sogs spangs kyang de dang ldan pa yod de/ sgom spang chen po de'i yul can lhag ma chung ngu'i skor rnams ma spangs bar du de dag gis dmigs pas chen po dang yang ldan par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa sems kyi dmigs pa bshad pa ni/ sdug bsngal rgyu mthong goms pa yis/ /spang bya 'dod khams las skyes pa/ /rang gi gsum dang gzugs gtogs gcig /dri med rnam shes spyod yul lo/ /gzugs khams las skyes rang gi ngang*/ /'og gsum gong gcig dri med kyi'ang*/

/gzugs med las skyes khams gsum gtogs/ /gsum dang zag med spyod yul lo/ /'gog dang lam mthong spang bya kun/ /rang gis glags pa'i spyod yul lo/ /zag med khams gsum mtha' gsum dang*/ /zag pa med pa'i spyod yul lo/ /zhes byung*/ spyir sdug bsngal mthong spang sogs spang bya rigs lnga lnga ste lnga dang zag med dang bcas pa'i chos bcu drug yod pas/ de rnams kyi yul can yang bcu drug yod de/ de yang sdug bsngal mthong spang dang rgyu kun 'byung mthong spang dang*/ goms pa ste sgom pa yi lam gyis spang bar bya ba dang 'dod khams las skyes pa chos can/ sems lnga'i spyod yul lam dmigs pa ste/ 'dod pa rang gi sas bsdus sdug kun mthong spang gnyis dang 'dod pa'i sgom spang ste gsum dang*/ gzugs su gtogs pa'i sgom spang gcig dang*/ dri med chos shes kyi phyogs rnam shes kyi spyod yul rang yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs khams su skyes pa'i sdug kun mthong spang dang sgom spang gsum po chos can/ sems brgyad kyi dmigs pa yin te/ rang gi sa'i sdug kun mthong spang gi sems gnyis dang sgom spang gi sems gcig ste gsum dang*/ 'og ma'i 'dod khams kyi mthong spang gi kun 'gro dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems gnyis dang sgom spang gi sems gcig ste gsum dang*/ gong ma gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs kyis bsdus pa gcig dang dri med ky-i shes pa'i spyod yul 'ang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med las skyes pa'i spang bya gsum po chos can/ rnam shes bcu'i dmigs pa yin te/ khams gsum du gtogs pa'i sdug kun mthong spang gnyis dang sgom spang gcig ste gsum gsum dang*/ zag med kyi spyod yul gcig yin pa'i phyir 'gog pa dang lam gyi mthong bas spang bya kun chos can/ rnam shes du ma'i spyod yul yin te/ 'dod par sngar bshad pa'i sems lnga'i steng du 'gog lam rang gi sems grags pa ste bstan pa'i rnam shes drug dang*/

gzugs khams kyi brgyad bshad pa'i steng du rang gi de bsnan pas dgu dang*/ gzugs med kyi bcur bshad pa'i steng du rang gi de bsnan pas bcu gcig gi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir/ zag med chos can/ rnam shes bcu'i spyod yul yin te/ khams gsum na spang bya mtha' sde tha ma 'gog lam mthong spang gcig dang sgom spang gcig ste gsum gsum dang*/ zag pa med pa'i sems kyi spyod yul gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ nyon mongs phra rgyas bcas rnam gnyis/ nyon mongs can min rgyas 'gyur gyis/ /zhes byung*/ nyon mongs can gyi phra rgyas chos can/ khyod la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ phra rgyas de rgyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ mi rgyas kyang phra rgyas dang bcas pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ spangs pa ni rgyas pa min gyi/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa ma spangs pa ni rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa skye tshul la/ skye ba'i go rim dang de'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ rmongs las the tshom de nas ni/ log lta de nas 'jig tshogs lta/ /de nas mthar 'dzin de nas ni/ /tshul khrims mchog 'dzin de nas lta/ rang gi lta la nga rgyal chags/ /gzhan la zhe sdang de ltar rim/ /zhes byung*/ nyon mongs phra rgyas rnams chos can/ khyod skye ba'i rim pa yod de/ dang por bden bzhi'i don la rmongs pa skye/ de las de yod dam med yin nam min snyam pa'i the tshom skye/ de nas rgyu mtshan phyin ci log la brten nas de dag med pa dang min snyam pa'i log lta skye/ de nas phung po la bdag tu lta ba'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba skye/ de nas de la rtag chad du lta ba'i mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba skye/ de nas des dag par 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin skye/ de nas lta ngan la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba mchog 'dzin skye/ de la brten nas rang gi lta ba la nga rgyal dang 'dod chags dang*/ gzhan gyi lta ba la zhe sdang ste de ltar rim pa bzhin du skye ba'i phy-ir/

gnyis pa ni/ phra rgyas spangs pa ma yin dang*/ /yul ni nye bar gnas pa dang*/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las/ /nyon mongs rgyu ni tshang ba yin/ /zhes byung*/ phra rgyas de rnams chos can/ rgyu dang yul dang sbyor ba gsum las skye ste/ phra rgyas nyon mongs spangs pa ma yin zhing ldan pa dang*/ nyon mongs skye ba'i yul gzugs sdug mi sdug ni nye bar gnas pa dang*/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa'i sbyor ba dang rgyu ni gsum tshang ba las skye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa rnam grangs la/ mdo las gsungs pa/ bstan bcos las gsungs pa/ zhar byung mtshungs ldan bshad pa/ spang bya sgrib pa lnga bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ so sor bshad pa dang*/ nges tshig bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zag pa dang*/ chu bo/ sbyor ba/ nye len dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'dod pa dang srid pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dod na gti mug ma gtogs pa'i/ /nyon mongs kun dang dkris bcas zag/ces byung*/ 'dod pa na gti mug ma gtogs pa'i nyon mongs so gcig dang kun dkris bcu dang bcas pa chos can/ 'dod pa'i zag pa yin te/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sogs ci rigs la dmigs pa'i 'khor bar zag byed yin pa'i phyir/ khyon zhe gcig yin te/ lta ba bcu gnyis/ the tshom bzhi/ chags sdang nga rgyal gsum la lnga lnga ste so gcig ngo tsha khrel med sogs bcu rnams yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs dang gzug ni med pa na/ phra rgyas kho na srid pa'i zag/de lung ma bstan kha nang bltas/ /mnyam bzhag sa pa'i phyir gcig byas/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams na ma rig pa bcu bor pa'i lhag ma phra rgyas lta ba bcu gnyis/ the tshom bzhi/ 'dod chags nga rgyal lnga lnga ste nyer drug re bcas pa'i phra rgyas lnga bcu rtsa gnyis chos can/ srid pa'i zag pa yin te/ phal cher gong sa'i nyon mongs la dmigs pa'i rigs gnas kyi zag pa yin pa'i phyir/ kho na'i don yod de/

kun dkris gcod pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gong ma gnyis kyi phra rgyas la srid pa'i zag pa zhes gcig tu byas pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis ka sgribs lung ma bstan du 'dra zhing*/ kha nang du bsdus pa 'dra ba dang*/ mnyam gzhag gi sa bar yang 'dra ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba ma rig yin pas na/ /logs shig tu ni zag par bstan/ /zhes byung*/ ma rig pa'i zag pa chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ khams gsum gyi ma rig pa lnga lnga ste bco lnga pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa chos can/ khyod logs shig tu zag par bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ zag pa gzhan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas na de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chu bo sbyor ba'ang de bzhin du/ /lha rnams gsal phyir logs shig bstan/ /zag pa ma yin grogs med rnams/ /'jog pa'i rjes su mi mthun no/ /zhes byung*/ chu bo dang sbyor ba gnyis chos can/ khyod la bzhi bzhi yod de/ zag pa 'dod pa dang srid pa dang ma rig pa'i zag pa gsum/ de bzhin du 'dod srid ma rig pa'i chu bo gsum dang*/ de gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum dang*/ lta ba'i chu bo dang sbyor ba re re/ bsnan nas bzhi bzhir byed pa'i phyir/ lta ba rnams ni lta ba'i chu bo dang sbyor ba zhes logs shig tu bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dmigs rnam gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/ bye smra na re/ zag par lta ba rnams logs su ma bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ zag pa'i nges tshig ni 'jog byed yin la/ grogs med pa'i lta ba rnams 'jog pa'i rjes su mi mthun pa'i phyir/ lo zhes pa'i don yod de/ slob dpon rang nyid de ltar mi bzhed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa nyer len ni/ ji skad bshad nyid ma rig bcas/ /nyer len rnam gnyis lta rnam gnyis/ phye ba'i phyir ro ma rig pa/ 'dzin pa byed pa min phyir bsres/ /ces byung nyer len rnams chos can/ rnam pa bzhi yod de/ gong du ji skad bshad pa nyid kyi 'dod pa'i sbyor ba nyer dgu ma rig pa lnga dang bcas pa'i so bzhi po 'dod pa nye bar len pa dang*/

srid pa'i sbyor ba nyer brgyad ma rig pa bcu dang bcas pa'i so brgyad ni bdag tu lta ba nye bar len pa rnam pa gnyis dang*/ lta ba'i sbyor ba la tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin drug dor ba'i lhag ma sum cu ni lta ba nye bar len pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang brtul bzhugs mchog 'dzin drug ni tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin nye bar len pa ste rnam pa gnyis su phye bas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa 'dod pa dag bdag tu lta ba nyer len gnyis su bsres nas ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyer len ni srid pa 'dzin pa'i don yin pas/ ma rig pa rkyang pas srid pa 'dzin par byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de mi gsal ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa nges tshig ni gang phyir de dag phra ba dang*/ /rjes 'brang rnam gnyis rgyas 'gyur dang*/ rjes su 'brang ba de yi phyir/ /phra rgyas dag tu bshad pa yin/ /de dag 'jog byed zag byed dang*/ /'phyar bar byed dang 'phyar byed dang*/ nye bar 'dzin phyir zag la sogs/ /de dag gi ni nges tshig yin/ /zhes byung*/ rtsa nyon de dag chos can/ phra rgyas dag tu bshad pa'i nges tshig gi don yod de/ rtogs dka' bas phra ba dang*/ thob pa dang rjes su 'brel ba dang*/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ bzlog pa la 'bad kyang rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ba de yi phyir/ nyon mongs de dag chos can/ khyod la zag pa sogs brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'khor bar 'jog par byed pa dang*/ zag par byed pa dang*/ skye gnas bzhir 'khyer ba dang*/ der 'dzin pa'am 'byar bar byed pa dang*/ nye bar 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir na zag pa dang sogs pas chu bo dang sbyor ba dang*/ nye bar len pa zhes pa ni de dag gi nges tshig gi don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bstan bcos las bshad pa'i rnam grangs la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dag kun tu sbyor sogs

kyi/ /dbye bas yang rnam lngar bshad do/ /zhes byung*/ phra rgyas de dag chos can/ yang rnam pa lngar bshad de/ kun tu sbyor ba dang*/ sogs kyis 'ching ba dang*/ phra rgyas dang*/ nye nyon dang*/ kun dkris kyi dbye bas de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kun sbyor/ 'ching ba/ nye nyon/ kun dkris dang bzhi/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdzas dang mchog 'dzin 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /lta gnyis kun tu sbyor gzhan no/ /gang phyir gnyis ka gcig tu ni/ /mi dge rang dbang de yi phyir/ phrag dog ser sna de dag las/ /logs shig tu ni kun sbyor bstan/ /zhes byung*/ lta ba mchog 'dzin dang tshul thugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba gnyis chos can/ lta ba'i kun tu sbyor ba gzhan gsum las gzhan pa'i kun sbyor gcig tu bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lta ba'i kun sbyor gzhan dag dang rdzas bco brgyad bco brgyad du 'dra ba dang*/ rdzas dang mchog tu 'dzin pa 'dra bas kun sbyaur gcig tu byas pa'i phyir/ phrag dog dang ser sna chos can/ kun sbyor brgyad bshad pa de dag gi nang nas logs shig tu kun sbyor dgu'i grangs gnyis su bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang gi phyir na gnyis ka mtha' gcig tu mi dge ba rang dbang can yin pa de yi phyir/ nyis pa zhar byung la/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga/ kun sbyor gsum/ gong ma'i cha mthun lnga bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tha ma'i cha dang mthun rnam lnga/ /gnyis kyis 'dod las mi 'da' la/ /gsum po yis ni phyir zlog byed/ /ces byung*/ kun sbyor la tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa lnga yod de/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ 'jig lta dang*/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang*/ the tshom nyon mongs can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de lnga'i byed las yod de/ dang po gnyis kyis 'dod pa'i khams las mi 'da' bar byed cing*/ phyi ma gsum po yis ni khams gong mar lan gcig skyes kyang 'dod par phyir zlog par byed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/

bye smra dang mdo sde pa'i lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgo dang rtsa bas bsdus phyir gsum/ zhes byung*/ rgyun zhugs kun sbyor tha ma gsum gyi mthong spang spangs pas rab tu phye nas ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sdug bden sogs yul gyi rnam pa ni gcig dang gnyis dang bzhi ste rnam pa sum tshan byas pa'i sgo yin pa dang*/ kun sbyor de gsum ni mthong spang gi rtsa ba yin pas des bsdus par grags pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ 'gro mi 'dod dang lam nor dang*/ lam la the tshom de snyed cig/thar par bgrod la gegs byed phyir/ /de la phyir na gsum bstan to/ /zhes byung*/ rgyun zhugs kyis kun sbyor de gsum spangs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de thar par bgrod pa'i gegs byed pa'i gtso bo la gsum po de snyed cig tu nges pa de yi phyir na kun sbyor gsum bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'jig ltas thar par 'gro mi 'dod par byed pa dang*/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi sa lam nor ba dang*/ the tshom gyi sa lam la the tshom za bar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ gong ma'i cha dang mthun lnga ni/ gzugs dang gzugs med las skyes pa'i/ /'dod chags gnyis rgod nga rgyal rmongs/ /zhes byung*/ kun tu sbyor ba gong ma'i cha dang mthun pa chos can/ khyod la lnga yod de/ gzugs dang gzugs med khams las skyes pa'i 'dod chags gnyis dang*/ gad pa dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ rmongs pa ma rig pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'ching ba bshad pa ni/ tshor ba'i dbang gis 'ching ba gsum/ zhes byung*/ 'ching ba chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ tshor ba bde ba'i dbang gis 'dod chags kyi 'ching ba/ sdug bsngal gyi dbang gis zhe sdang gi 'ching ba/ btang snyoms kyi dbang gis gti mug gi 'ching ba gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa nye nyon ni nyon mongs las gzhan nyon mongs can/ /sems byung 'du byed phung zhes

pa/ /gang de'ang nye ba'i nyon mongs de/ /de dag nyon mongs zhes mi bya/ /zhes byung*/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs can sems byung 'du byed kyi phung pos bsdus pa bshad cing 'chad par 'gyur ba'i khro ba dang ngo tsha med pa sogs nyi shu gang yin pa de'ang chos can/ nyon mongs yin te/ nye ba'i nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ de dag chos can/ khyod la rtsa ba'i nyon mongs zhes mi bya ste/ rtsa nyon dang nye ba'i nyon mongs tsam yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa kun dkris la/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung dri ma drug bshad pa dang khyad chos bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba dang*/ rgyu gang las byung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bstan bcos rab tu byed pa nas bshad tshul dang*/ bye brag smra ba'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngo tsha med dang khrel med dang*/ /phrag dog ser sna rgod pa dang*/ /'gyod dang rmugs dang gnyid dang ni/ /kun nas dkris pa rnam pa brgyad/ /zhes byung*/ kun dkris chos can/ khyod la brgyad yod de/ ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa dang*/ phrag dog dang*/ ser sna dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ 'gyod pa dang*/ rmugs pa dang*/ gnyid dang bcas pa'i kun nas dkris pa rnam pa brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyu ni/ khro dang 'chab po'o zhes byung*/ bye smra na re/ de la bcu yod de/ snga ma brgyad kyi steng du khro ba dang 'chab pa gnyis bsnan pas bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags kyis/ ngo tsha med rgod ser sna bslang*/ /'chab pa rtsod do ma rig las/ /rmugs dang gnyid dang khrel med do/ /the tshom las 'gyod khro ba dang*/ /phrag dog khong khro'i rgyu las byung*/ /zhes byung*/ ngo tsha med pa dang rgod pa dang ser sna gsum chos can/ rgyu gang las byung ba yod de/ 'dod chags kyis kun nas bslang bas de dang nye zhing de las byung ba'i phyir/ 'chab pa'i rgyu la rtsod de/ kha cig ma rig pa las byung zer la/ gzhan dag sred pa dang 'dod chags las kyang byung zhes zer ba'i phyir/

rmugs pa dang gnyid dang khrel med gsum chos can/ ma rig pa las byung ste/ des kun nas bslang ba'i phyir/ 'gyod pa chos can/ the tshom las byung ste/ des kun nas bslang ba'i phyir/ khro ba phrag dog chos can/ khong khro'i rgyu las byung ste/ des kun nas bslang zhing de dang nye ba'i phyir gnyis pa la/ dbye ba dang*/ rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan yang nyon mongs dri ma drug /sgyu dang g.yo dang rgyags pa dang*/ /de bzhin 'tshig dang 'khon 'dzin dang*/ /rnam 'tshe'o zhes byung*/ kun dkris bcu las gzhan yang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma chos can/ khyod la drug yod de/ sgyu dang g.yo dang rgyags pa dang de bzhin du 'tshig pa dang 'khon 'dzin dang rnam par 'tshe ba dang drug yod pa'i/ de drug chos can/ dri ma zhes bya ste/ lus las dri ngan 'byung ba ltar khyod rtsa nyon las byung ba'i nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi khyad par yod de/ sgyu ni gzhan 'drid pa dang*/ g.yo ni sems gya gyu dang*/ 'tshig pa ni nyes pa dam por 'dzin pa dang*/ 'khon 'dzin ni mnar sems dang*/ /rnam 'tshe ni gzhan la tho 'tsham pa zhig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyu ni/ sgyu dang rgyags pa ni/ 'dod chags las skyes 'khon 'dzin dang*/ /rnam 'tshe khong khro las skyes so/ /'tshig dang lta dang mchog 'dzin las/ /g.yon lta bas kun nas bslang*/ /zhes byung*/ de drug chos can/ rgyu rtsa nyon gang las byung ba yod de/ sgyu dang rgyags pa ni 'dod chags las skyes/ 'khon du 'dzin pa dang rnam 'tshe ni khong khro las skyes/ 'tshig pa ni lta ba mchog 'dzin las skyes/ g.yon lta ba ngan pas kun nas bslang ba'i phyir/ gsum pa khyad chos la/ mthong sgom gyi spang bya'i khyad par/ dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi khyad par/ khams dang sa'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de las ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med rmugs gnyid rgod rnam gnyis/ /de las gzhan ni sgom spang bya/ /rang dbang de bzhin dri ma

rnams/ /zhes byung*/ ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa dang rmugs gnyid dang rgod pa lnga chos can/ khyod la mthong sgom gyi spang bya rnam pa gnyis yod de/ mthong sgom rang rang gi spang bya dang mtshungs ldan gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan phrag dog ser sna khong 'chab pa 'gyod pa lnga chos can/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba yin te/ ma rig pa tsam dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs rang dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du g.yo dang sgyu sogs dri ma drug po rnams chos can/ sgom spang yin te/ rang dbang can gyi nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod na mi dge gsum rnam gnyis/ /de yan chad ni lung ma bstan/ /zhes byung*/ de dag las mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi khyad par yod de/ 'dod par nyon mongs can gyi gnyid rmugs rgod gsum la mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi cha rnam pa gnyis yod cing*/ de yan chad de khams gong na ni kun dkris dang dri ma rnams ni lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po na/ g.yo sgyu tshangs pas 'drid phy-ir ro/ /rmugs rgod rgyags pa khams gsum na/ /gzhan dag 'dod khams las skyes pa/ /zhes byung*/ kun dkris dang dri ma de dag las khams gang na yod med kyi khyad par yod de/ g.yo sgyu gnyis 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po na yod cing*/ dang po der tshangs pas g.yo sgyus gzhan 'drid pa'i phyir dang*/ rmugs rgod rgyags pa ni khams gsum na dang*/ de lnga las gzhan ngo tsha med pa sogs bcu gcig dag ni 'dod khams las skyes pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mtshungs ldan la/ gtso sems gang la mtshungs par ldan tshul dang tshor ba gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthong spang bya gnyid nga rgyal bcas/ /yid kyi rnam shes sa pa yin/ nye ba'i nyon mongs rang dbang yang*/ /gzhan ni rnam shes drug rten can/ /zhes byung*/ nyon mongs de dag las mthong bas spang bya'i nyon mongs thams cad dang sgom spang gnyid dang nga rgyal bcas pa chos can/

yid kyi rnam shes kyi sa pa yin te/ de kho na'i 'khor du 'byung ba'i phyir/ nye ba'i nyon mongs rang dbang can phrag dog ser sna 'gyod khro 'chab chos can/ yid kyi rnam shes kyi sa pa yin te/ rtags de'i phyir/ gzhan 'dod chags khong khro sogs rtsa nyon dang nye nyon ngo tsha med khrel med rmugs rgod bag med le lo ma dad pa rnams chos can/ rnam shes drug gi rten can yin te/ de dag gi 'khor du 'byung ba'i nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ rtsa nyon tshor ba gang dang*/ nye nyon tshor ba dang gang dang mtshungs par ldan tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dod pa dang*/ khams gong ma'i mtshungs par ldan tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bde ba dag dang 'dod chags su/ / mtshungs ldan zhe sdang bzlog pa'o/ /ma rig pa dag thams cad dang*/ /med lta yid bde sdug bsngal dang*/ /yid mi bde dang the tshom mo/ /gzhan yid bde dang 'dod las skyes/ btang snyoms dang kun zhes byung*/ rtsa nyon 'dod khams kyi nyon mongs dang chor ba bde sdug sogs gang dang mtshungs par ldan tshul yod de/ 'dod chags ni lus dang yid kyi bde ba dag dang mtshungs ldan du 'jug pa yod/ zhe sdang ni de las bzlog pa lus yid kyi sdug bsngal dang yi dam bde ba dag dang*/ ma rig pa dag ni tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms thams cad dang*/ med lta ni yid bde ba dang sdug bsngal gnyis dang*/ the tshom ni yid mi bde ba dang*/ gzhan rtsa nyon gzhan pa lta ba bzhi dang nga rgyal ni rang gi grogs yid bde dang lhan cig mtshungs ldan du 'jug pa'i phyir/ de rnams chos can/ khams gang du skyes tshul yod de/ 'dod pa las skyes pa'i phyir/ dmigs bsal tshor ba btang snyoms phra rgyas bcu po kun dang so sor mtshungs ldan du song ba zhig yod de/ dmigs rnam mi gsal bas de rnams lhan cig 'jug pa mi 'gal ba'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa ni/ sa gong ma/ sa ji bzhin du rang rang dang*/ /zhes byung*/ sa gong ma gzugs gzugs med kyi phra rgyas rnams chos can/

sa gang na tshor ba'i dbang po ji lta ba bzhin rang rang gi grogs tshor ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa yod de/ bsam gtan dang po na mig rna ba lus gsum gyi rnam shes kyi bde ba'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa/ de yan na nyon mongs can phal cher dang tshor ba btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ 'gyod dang phrag dog khro ba dang*/ /rnam 'tshe 'khon du 'dzin pa dang*/ 'tsheg pa yid mi bde ba dang*/ /ser sna dag ni bzlog pa yin/ /g.yo dang sgyu dang 'chab dang gnyid/ /gnyis ka dang ldan bde dag dang*/ /rgyags pa btang snyoms kun tu 'gro/ /bzhi po gzhan ni lnga dag dang*/ /zhes byung*/ nye nyon tshor ba gang dang mtshungs ldan du 'jug tshul yod de/ 'gyod pa dang phrag dog dang khro ba dang rnam 'tshe dang 'khon du 'dzin pa dang 'tshig pa drug ni rang gi grogs yid mi bde ba dang mtshungs ldan du 'jug / ser sna ni de las bzlog pa yid bde dang*/ g.yo dang sgyu dang 'chab pa dang gnyid bzhi ni skabs 'gar yid bde mi bde gnyis ka gang rung dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ bsam gtan/ gsum pa man chad yid bde dang*/ gsum pa de bde ba'i dbang po dag dang rgyags pa dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ tshor ba btang snyoms ni khams gsum po kun tu 'gro zhing*/ gzhan ngo tsha med pa khrel med rmugs rgod bzhi po ni tshor ba lnga po dag dang mtshungs ldan du 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa sgrib pa lnga ni/ 'dod na sgrib rnams mi mthun dang*/ /zas dang bya ba gcig pa'i phyir/ /gnyis gcig phung po gnod byed dang*/ /the tshom phyir na lnga nyid do/ /zhes byung*/ mdo las sgrib pa lnga zhes gsungs pa yod de/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ gnyid rmugs dang*/ rgod 'gyod dang*/ the tshom nyon mongs can lnga yin pa'i phyir/ gnyid rmugs gnyis po ni 'dir sgrib pa rigs gcig tu 'jog cing*/ 'gyod rgod gnyis kyang gcig tu 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de dag gi 'gal zla mi mthun phyogs de gnyen po dang zas dang bya ba gsum gcig pa'i phyir/

gnyid rmugs gnyis kyis de gsum gcig ste/ de gnyis kyi gnyen po khyad par ba ni snang ba'i 'du shes su gcig /zas rmya ba dang mi dga' ba dang bya rmyang dang kha zas tshod mi zin pa bzhi yang gcig /bya ba yang sems zhum par gcig pa'i phyir/ 'gyod rgod gnyis kyi de gsum yang gcig ste/ gnyen po ni zhi gnas/ zas ni/ sngar dgod pa dang rtses pa sogs dran nas rnam par rtog pa yang gcig /bya ba ni sems ma zhi bar byed par gcig pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa lnga po de las 'dod pa la 'dun pa sogs gsum gyi gnyen po sogs gsum so so ba yin te/ 'dod 'dun gyi gnyen po mi sdug pa/ zas sdug pa'i mtshan ma/ gnod sems kyi gnyen po byams pa/ zas khong khro/ /the tshom gyi gnyen po rten 'brel rtogs pa/ zas dus gsum yin la/ bya ba yang rim pa bzhin du srid pa rgyas pa dang*/ sems ma zhi bar byed pa dang*/ yin tshul mi rtogs pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa la lnga nyid du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'dod 'dun dang gnod sems gnyis kyis tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ gnyid rmugs gnyis kyi shes rab la gnod/ 'gyod rgod gnyis kyis ting nge 'dzin skyes ba la gnod par byed/ the tshom gcig gis ni de gsum la gnod pa'i dbang du byas nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbong byed gnyen po bshad pa la/ gnyen po gang gis spang bya gang spong ba gnyen po'i dbye ba/ thag sring pa'i gnyen po/ /rten gyi gnyen po bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dmigs pas yongs su shes pa dang*/ /de la dmigs pa yang dag par/ /zas dang dmigs pas spangs pas so/ /gnyen po skyes pas zad par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung*/ nyon mongs de rnams chos can/ /spong tshul yod de/ /dmigs pa bden pa bzhi la dmigs pa'i sgo nas yongs su shes pas spong ba dang*/ de la dmigs pa'i byed pa yang dag par spong bas zad pa dang*/ de la dmigs pa spangs pa'i sgo nas spong ba dang gnyen po skyes pas zad par 'gyur ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ gnyen po rnam bzhi spong ba dang*/ /gzhi dang srid nyid rnam par ni/ /sun 'byin zhes bya dmigs pa las/ /nyon mongs pa ni spang byar 'dod/ /ces byung*/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po chos can/ khyod la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ spong ba'i gnyen po dang*/ gzhi'i gnyen po dang*/ thag sring ba'i gnyen po nyid dang*/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po zhes bya ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa chos can/ gang la brten nas spong tshul yod de/ yul gang la phyin ci log tu dmigs pa'i zhen yul med par shes pa las spang bar bya bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyen po bzhi'i khyad par yod de/ bar chad med lam dang po rnams spong ba'i gnyen po yin la/ sdug bsngal chos bzod yan gyi rnam grol dang bar chad med lam ni gzhi'i gnyen po/ sdug bsngal chos shes ma gtogs pa yan chad ni thag sring ba'i gnyen po/ khams gang la skyon du mthong nas nyon mongs de spong ba'i lam ni sun 'byin pa'i gnyen por 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni/ mtshan nyid mi mthun mi mthun phyogs/ /yul rnam chad dang dus kyis te/ /'byung dang tshul khrims phyaugs dang ni/ /dus gnyis ring ba nyid lta bu/ /lan cig tu zad de dag ni/ /bral ba'i thob pa yang dang yang*/ /gnyen po skyes dang 'bras thob dang*/ /dbang po rnam par 'phel rnams su/ /zhes byung*/ thag sring ba'i gnyen po chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ mtshan nyid mi mthun pas ring ba/ mi mthun phyogs kyis ring ba/ yul rnam par chad pas ring ba/ dus kyi sgo nas ring ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ 'byung ba bzhi lta bu dang po dang*/ tshul khrims dang 'chal tshul lta bu gnyis pa dang*/ phyogs shar nub kyi rgya mtsho lta bu gsum pa dang*/ dus 'das ma 'ongs gnyis ring ba nyid lta bu bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs thams cad ni zad kyang gnyen pos yang yang spong ba min gyi lan gcig tu zad par byed la/

'on kyang bral ba de dag gi thob pa ni yang dang yang du 'byung ste gnyen po rnam grol lam skyes dus dang dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu bzhi thob dus dang*/ dbang po rtul po dbang rnon du rnam par 'phel ba'i dus rnams su bral thob khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gsum pa spangs pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes la/ dbye ba/ lam gang gi spang bya gang yin pa/ grangs nges/ gang zag gang la ldan pa/ thob gtong bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ yongs su shes dag 'dod pa na/ /dang po rnam gnyis zad la gcig /gnyis zad pa ni de gnyis so/ /de bzhin gong ma'i de gsum nyid/ /yongs su shes pa gzhan gsum ste/ /tha ma'i cha dang mthun gzugs dang*/ zag pa kun zad ces byung*/ /yongs su shes pa chos can/ khyod la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na gnyis yod de/ ye shes yongs shes dang*/ spangs pa yongs shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ spangs pa yongs su shes pa chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ 'dod pa na dang po sdug kun mthong spang rnam gnyis zad pa la yongs shes cig /'gog lam mthong spangs gnyis zad pa'i yongs shes de gnyis/ de bzhin du khams gong ma'i mthong spang spangs pa'i de gsum nyid dang*/ yongs su shes pa gzhan sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma gsum yod de/ tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa lnga spangs pa dang*/ gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi zag pa kun zad pa'i yongs shes rnams su yod pa'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa ni/ drug bzod 'bras/ lhag ma rnams kyi shes pa'i len/ /mi lcogs med 'bras thams cad de/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi lnga'am brgyad/ /nye bar bsdogs pa'i gcig yin te/ /gzugs med dngos gzhi gsum gyi yang*/ /thams cad 'phags pa'i lam gyi yin/ /'jig rten pa'i gnyis rjes kyi yang*/ /chos shes pa'i ni gsum yin no/ /de'i phyogs mthun gyi drug dang lnga/ /zhes byung*/ spangs pa'i yongs shes drug chos can/

rang thob byed kyi mthong lam bzod pa de'i 'bras bu zhes bya ste/ de'i bral 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ lhag ma sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum rnams chos can/ chos shes pa'i 'bras bu zhes bya ste/ de'i bral 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med chos can/ khyod kyi bral 'bras du ma yod de/ khyod la brten nas thob pa'i yongs shes dgu po thams cad de yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi rnams chos can/ khyod kyi bral 'bras yongs shes lnga lnga yod de/ khams gong gi mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum/ gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i de gcig dang*/ zag pa kun zad pa'i de gcig yod pa'i phyir zhes bye smra zer/ dbyangs sgrogs na re/ de'i dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu brgyad yod de/ snga ma lnga'i steng du 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum yod pa'i phyir zer/ gzugs med nam mkha'i nye bar bsdogs pa chos can/ khyod kyi bral 'bras yongs shes gcig yin te/ gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i yongs shes de de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi dang po gsum chos can/ khyod kyi bral 'bras yang gcig yin te/ zag pa kun zad pa'i yongs shes gcig yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i yongs shes thams cad chos can/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi bral 'bras yin te/ dang po drug mthong lam gyi dang phyi ma gsum sgom lam gyi bral 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom pa'i lam chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu yongs shes yang gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pa dang gzugs kyi sgom spang spangs pa'i de gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam rjes shes chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu yongs shes yang gnyis yin te/ der gyur pa'i yongs shes tha ma gnyis yod pa'i phy-ir/ sgom lam chos shes pa chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu yongs shes dgu'i tha ma gsum yod pa yin te/

tha ma'i cha mthun/ gzugs kyi zag pa/ zag pa thams cad spangs pa'i de gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam chos shes de'i phyogs mthun chos shes pa'i bzod pa rnams dang chos shes rnams chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu yongs shes drug yod de/ mthong spang dang sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rjes shes kyi phyogs mthun rjes bzod rjes shes chos can/ khyod kyi bral 'bras yongs shes lnga yod de/ gong ma'i mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum dang yongs shes tha ma gnyis dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grangs nges ni/ bral ba'i thob pa zag med dang*/ /srid rtse nyams par byas pa dang*/ /rgyu gnyis kun du bcom pa'i phyir/ /yongs shes khams las 'das pa las/ /zhes byung*/ so skye la yongs shes mi 'jog par yongs shes dgur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bral ba'i thob pa zag med rnyed pa dang*/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs kyi phyogs re nyams pa ste spangs par byas pa dang*/ srid rtse'i sdug kun mthong spang kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis bcom pa'i rgyu mtshan gsum gyis mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug dang*/ rgyu gsum po de dang rgyu bzhi pa khams gsum so so las 'das pa ste 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yongs shes tha ma gsum bzhag pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/ gcig min mthong la gnas pa ni/ /lnga yi bar dang yang dag ldan/ /sgom la gnas pa drug gam ni/ /gcig gam yang na gnyis dang ngo*/ khams las 'dod chags bral ba dang*/ 'bras bu thob phyir de dag bsdoms/ zhes byung*/ re zhig la gcig ste so skye ni chos can/ yongs shes dang mi ldan pa kho na yin te/ bral thob zag med dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ mthong lam la gnas pa chos can/ yongs shes gcig nas lnga'i bar ci rigs yang dag par ldan te/ mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi bar rgyu gnyis bcom pa med pas yongs shes dang mi ldan cing*/

kun 'byung chos shes pa yongs shes gcig dang ldan/ kun 'byung rjes shes pa snga ma dang sdug kun mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gnyis dang ldan/ 'gog pa chos shes pa snga ma gnyis dang rang gi de dang gsum dang ldan/ 'gog pa rjes shes snga ma bzhi dang rang gi de dang lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sgom lam la gnas pa chos can/ yongs shes drug gam yang na gcig gam gnyis dang ldan te/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa chags bral min pa dang yongs su nyams pa ni mthong spang spangs pa'i de drug dang*/ chags bral sngon song gi lam rjes shes pa ni tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i re gcig dang rim gyis pa phyir mi 'ong thob pa'i tshe dang*/ dgra bcom thob pa'i tshe yang yongs shes gcig dang*/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i tshe tha ma dang gong ma'i cha mthun gnyis spangs pa'i de gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ phyir 'od dang dgra bcom thob pa'i tshe yongs shes re re ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyir mi 'ong gis 'dod khams la chags pa dang bral nas gzugs kyi de dang ma bral bar du 'bras bu thob pa de dag gcig tu dang*/ dgra bcom thob pa'i tshe kun sbyor thams cad spangs pa'i sgo nas yongs shes rnams gcig tu bsdoms par byas pa'i phyir/lnga pa ni/ la la gcig gnyis lnga dang drug /gtong ste thob pa lnga min no/ /zhes byung*/ gang zag la la ni yongs shes gcig gtong pa yod de/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu las nyams nas phyir mi 'ong du gyur pa'i zag pa kun zad kyi 'bras bu gtong zhing*/ phyir mi 'ong nyams pas kyang tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes gcig gtong ba'i phyir/ la la gnyis gtong ba yod de/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba 'dod nyon gyis nyams pa'i tshe yongs shes bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis gtong ba'i phyir/ la la lnga gtong ba yod de/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong lam rjes shes pas tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pa'i de thob pa'i tshe mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes lnga gtong ba'i phyir/

la la drug gtong ba yod de/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i mthar gyis pa nyams nas phyir 'ong du gnas 'gyur ba'i tshe mthong sbang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug gtong ba'i phyir/ thob pa'i tshe gcig dang gnyis dang drug thob pa gsum las gcig thob pa la yang bzhi yod de/ rgyun zhugs kyis kun 'byung chos shes la gnas pa'i tshe yongs shes dgu'i dang po gcig thob/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong lam rjes shes pas tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i gcig thob/ sgom lam la rim gyis pas 'dod nyon spangs pa'i tshe yang cha mthun de spangs pa'i gcig thob/ dgra bcom pa thob pa'i tshe yang yongs shes dgu pa gcig pu thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis thob pa yod de/ dgra bcom pa gzugs med kyi nyon mongs kho nas nyams na tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i de dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags spangs pa'i de gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ drug thob pa la gnyis yod de/ dgra bcom pa dang 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'dod nyon gyis nyams pa na mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug dang ldan par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gtong ste 'thob pa'i tshul de ltar yin gyi/ nyams pa'i yongs shes lnga cig car thob pa ni yod pa yin te/ 'dod pa dang chags bral sngon du 'gro la ni yongs su nyams pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /spyi 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes thob na/ mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes thob pas ma khyab ste/ khams 'og ma'i mthong spang spangs kyang gong ma'i mthong spang ma spangs pa du ma yod pa'i phyir/ gzhung 'di dag gi dngos bstan gyi yongs shes ni spangs pa yongs shes gtso che yang yongs shes mtshan nyid pa la 'dod pa mi mthun pa yod de/ kha cig ye shes yongs shes ni yongs shes mtshan nyid pa yin gyi/ spangs pa yongs shes ni der btags pa tsam du bzhed la/ kha cig ni de las ldog ste bzhed kyang snga ma ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gnas lnga pa legs par bshad zin to/
